4006:

4012:
**περί**, 
_prep._ with genitive, accusative (in cl. also with dative; cf. M, _Pr._, 105f.), 
with radical sense **round about** (as distinct from ἀμφί, _on both sides_). 
I. C. genitive, 
1. of place, **about** (poët.). 
2. Causal, **about, on account of, concerning, in reference to**: [[40-matthew.2.8|Mat.2:8]], [[41-mark.1.44|Mrk.1:44]], [[42-luke.4.38|Luk.4:38]], [[43-john.16.26|Jhn.16:26]], [[44-acts.28.21|Act.28:21]], al. mult.; τὰ περί, with genitive, **the things concerning** one, **one's _state_ or _case_**: [[41-mark.5.27|Mrk.5:27]], [[44-acts.1.3|Act.1:3 28:15]], [[49-ephesians.6.22|Eph.6:22]], al.; at the beginning of a sentence, περί, **regarding, as to**, [[46-1-corinthians.7.1|1Co.7:1]], al.; in the sense **on account of** ([[40-matthew.26.28|Mat.26:28]], [[46-1-corinthians.1.13|1Co.1:13]], al.), often with ὑπέρ as variant (cf. M, _Pr._, 105). 
II. C. accusative, 
1. of place, **about, around**: [[40-matthew.3.4|Mat.3:4]], [[41-mark.1.6|Mrk.1:6]], [[42-luke.13.8|Luk.13:8]], [[44-acts.22.6|Act.22:6]], al.; οἱ περί, with accusative of person(s), of one's associates, friends, etc., [[41-mark.4.10|Mrk.4:10]], [[42-luke.22.49|Luk.22:49]], [[43-john.11.19|Jhn.11:19]], [[44-acts.13.13|Act.13:13]]; οἱ περὶ τ. τοιαῦτα ἐργάται, [[44-acts.19.25|Act.19:25;]] metaphorically, **about, as to, concerning**: [[54-1-timothy.1.19|1Ti.1:19 6:4]] [[55-2-timothy.2.18|2Ti.2:18 3:8]], [[56-titus.2.7|Tit.2:7]]; τὰ περὶ ἐμέ, [[50-philippians.2.23|Php.2:23;]] αἱ περὶ τ. λοιπὰ ἐπιθυμίαι, [[41-mark.4.19|Mrk.4:19.]] 
2. Of time, in a loose reckoning, **about, near**: [[40-matthew.20.3|Mat.20:3, 5 6, 9 27:46]], [[41-mark.6.48|Mrk.6:48]], [[44-acts.10.3|Act.10:3, 9 22:6]]. 
III. **In composition**: **round about** (περιβάλλω, περίκειμαι), **beyond, over and above** (περιποιέω, περιλείπω), **to excess** (περιεργάζομαι, περισσεύω). 
(AS)

(τρώγειν) τὴν σ. τοῦ υἱοῦ τ. ἀνθρώπου, [[43-john.6.52|Jhn.6:52-56;]]

2. As in Heb. idiom, 
(a) **of a living creature**: πᾶσα σ. (Heb. כָּל־בָּשָׂר; cf. Bl., §47, 9), [[40-matthew.24.22|Mat.24:22]], [[41-mark.13.20|Mrk.13:20]], [[60-1-peter.1.24|1Pe.1:24]]; esp. of man and his mortality (Psa.55 (56):5, Sir.28:5, al.), [[43-john.1.14|Jhn.1:14]]; πᾶσα σ.
